_meta.datasheet_section: p2 Package Dimensions (front view, window cap removed) + internal schematic; p1 ratings/characteristics
_meta.package: TO-8 6-pin hermetic, cap dia 15.40 +/-0.2, height 4.50, leads dia 0.45 x 12.7 min; 2 rows of 3 at 2.54 pitch, rows 10.16 apart
_meta.notes: Common-cathode quad photodiode; cathode = pin 2 = backside butt weld (the can sits at cathode potential). Peak response 950 nm; ~0.2 A/W at 1064 nm (p3 curve). VBR >= 50 V; Cj 140 pF @0 V, 25 pF @10 V per quadrant. Operating temperature -40..+85 C; lead soldering 260 C for 5 s, >= 3 mm from the body. [height_max_mm: DS p2 Package Dimensions: 4.50 from window cap to base, tolerance ±0.15] [temp] DS Absolute Maximum Ratings: Topr −40…+85 °C
_meta.abs_max_notes: DS p.1 Absolute Maximum Ratings lists only Topr, Tstg and lead soldering temperature: no reverse-voltage or current rating, so no pin limits recorded. The only voltage figure is the characteristic VBR >= 50 V min at IR 10 uA (p.1 Electrical & Optical Characteristics, per quadrant), which is not an abs-max rating; dark current is specified at VR 10 V.

pins.name: CATHODE_COM
pins.note: common cathode, welded to the case: the metal can is at this potential, so insulate it from the chassis
